manual_journeys.name: Consumer: pre-order with table booking
steps: After booking a table, the app offers a 'Preorder' option.
Tap Preorder to browse the menu and select items.
After selecting an item, tap 'Add to Cart'.
Open the cart and proceed to place the order.
Payment MUST be completed at this step -- a preorder cannot be placed without paying for it then and there.
If only a table booking is wanted (no preorder), ordering can instead be done from the Waiter side during the appointment itself.

manual_journeys.name: Waiter: handling an incoming order through to payment
steps: When an order comes in, the waiter assigns a table to the reservation.
The waiter sends the consumer's preorder to the kitchen.
The waiter can also add further items to the order and send those to the kitchen too.
Once a dish is ready, the waiter serves it and marks it Served in the app.
After every dish on the order has been served, the waiter can notify that payment is due.
Payment can be completed from either the Waiter side or the Consumer side.

manual_journeys.name: Kitchen: preparing an order through pickup
steps: Once an order comes in, the kitchen begins preparing it.
When a dish is ready, the kitchen marks it Ready.
The waiter then comes to the kitchen to pick up the order.
An order only becomes visible on the kitchen dashboard once there are 15 minutes or less remaining until its pickup time.
